name: The Traveler's lightsaber
description: The Traveler's lightsaber was the Jedi lightsaber and scion's blade wielded by the Traveler. They did not construct it themselves, instead inheriting it as the bloodline heir of a Jedi clan. The lightsaber hilt had a dark leather strip wound around it and metal shards of ornamentation, with wooden pegs securing the sides, and a durasteel core.
